commit_clusters.a4229b80e2be: codegen-core (RISCVISelLowering.cpp): v2i16/v4i8 ISD::SELECT promoted to i32, ISD::SELECT_CC expanded

summary: B144: v2i16/v4i8 had no SELECT/SELECT_CC action since fork commit f1b7aebff8c2, so they reached ISel as 'legal' and crashed. Fix: setOperationPromotedToType(ISD::SELECT, VT, i32) + SELECT_CC Expand in the fork's v2i16/v4i8 block (6 lines, no .td change, RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td untouched). The i32 select then follows the upstream XLenVT path (lowerSELECT -> RISCVISD::SELECT_CC -> Select_GPR_Using_CC_GPR). Promote chosen over Custom+pseudo because upstream lowerSELECT turns vector SELECT into splat-VSELECT (RISCVISelLowering.cpp:8344 at llvmorg-20.1.8); precedent AMDGPUISelLowering.cpp:553-554.
